verification: Primary publisher abstract/pages were checked, then exact DOI, title, journal and publication dates were confirmed with Crossref REST works metadata. No manuscript or figure was copied. These papers motivate the method choices; the lesson does not claim to replicate them.
academicMCP: Core academic-search / Crossref MCP tools were not available in this session; fallback used primary publisher web search/open and https://api.crossref.org/works/{doi}.

papers.title: Transfer learning for acoustic cement bond evaluation: An image classification approach using acoustic variable Density log
papers.methodVerified: VDL -> Continuous Wavelet Transform -> image classification with pretrained CNNs and transfer learning.
papers.lessonBoundary: Raw synthetic 3-depth VDL patches and CBL -> trained small MLP; no CWT or transfer learning. No paper accuracy is copied into lesson results.

papers.title: A Cement Bond Quality Prediction Method Based on a Wide and Deep Neural Network Incorporating Embedded Domain Knowledge
papers.methodVerified: Wide and Deep neural network incorporating embedded domain knowledge for cement bond quality prediction.
papers.lessonBoundary: Illustrates a knowledge/data fusion research direction. The lesson does not implement Wide and Deep or its domain-knowledge branch.

papers.title: Optimizing cementing displacement efficiency using a machine learning ensemble Models: Application of fluent simulation and optimization algorithms
papers.methodVerified: Fluent simulations form a response dataset; ML ensembles predict displacement efficiency; optimization algorithms compare cementing parameters.
papers.lessonBoundary: Simple synthetic response, fitted polynomial ridge surrogate and constrained grid. No Fluent, stacking ensemble or field validation was run.

papers.title: Intelligent Prediction of Lost Circulation and Gas Invasion in Cementing Operations Based on ACO-SWXGBoost
papers.methodVerified: Flow, pressure, density and slopes; sliding windows; enhanced XGBoost; ACO hyperparameter search; three categories.
papers.lessonBoundary: Binary synthetic loss classification by actual fitted logistic regression plus calibration-only threshold search. No ACO/XGBoost or gas-invasion classification.

papers.title: Adaptive segmentation and optimization for efficient centralizer selection and placement in oilfield drilling operations
papers.methodVerified: Black-box constrained centralizer placement and selection; parallel bisection, adaptive segmentation and approximate type enumeration, not deep learning.
papers.lessonBoundary: Ideal simply-supported beam and exact small combinatorial enumeration. No industrial simulator, type search or reported field cost reduction is replicated.

glossaryBoundary: Casing standoff ratio is explicitly defined geometrically in the lesson. The SLB general standoff entry concerns logging/perforating and is deliberately not used as a cementing-ratio authority.
